train_faster_rcnn_voc: train a Faster R-CNN R50 FPN model on Pascal VOC 0712 with 4 epochs and SGD optimizer
configure_faster_rcnn_classes: configure Faster R-CNN ROI head bbox head to detect 20 Pascal VOC object classes
setup_training_loop: setup epoch-based training loop with validation every epoch and multi-step learning rate decay
configure_lr_scheduler: configure multi-step learning rate scheduler with milestone at epoch 3 and gamma 0.1
configure_optimizer_sgd: configure SGD optimizer with learning rate 0.01, momentum 0.9, and weight decay 0.0001
